text:
This summary covers the period from 2026-06-04 to 2026-06-10, during which ROBI processed a total of 129 orders. Of these, 22 were successfully delivered, 22 were delivered with warnings, and 85 resulted in a failed status. The average fetch time was 54 seconds, with 47 seconds spent by the robot itself, and a median fetch time of 64 seconds. 

Notably, ROBI handled a high volume of specific items this week, with pens, t-shirts, water bottles, and balls being the most frequently picked – 44, 41, 22, and 22 respectively. There were a significant number of failures, with [[reachability]]_failed occurring 44 times, [[no-valid-depth]] 22 times, and [[handover]]_failed 21 times. A total of 88 retries were recorded across all orders, with 44 orders requiring a [[retry]], and 440 collision warnings were issued.
